svg.title: PayLink - UNKNOWN payment later confirmed COMPLETED (UC16, US-13.3, US-14, US-26.4)

g.text: PayLink - UNKNOWN payment later confirmed COMPLETED (UC16, US-13.3, US-14, US-26.4)
Start state: payment is UNKNOWN, the hold is still ACTIVE.
No refund was made (UNKNOWN is never refunded automatically).
[a re-query (after 1, 5 or 15 minutes) or a callback gets CONFIRMED]
[the settlement file lists the payment as paid (US-26.4)]
check status is UNKNOWN (else ignore and log)
LedgerEntry COMMISSION (agent wallet, 40% of the fee)
insert(one row per ledger entry, refId = ledger entry id) (NFR-05)
A failed send is retried 3 times and never changes the payment.
The fee of the payment was fixed when the payment was created
(FeeCalculator at that day), so the amounts are the same as in a
payment that was CONFIRMED at once (seq-pay-bill.puml).
